exposure: recombinant human LH (rhLH) supplementation with recombinant human FSH (rhFSH)
outcome: live birth rate (after first embryo transfer)
cohort: The study included 791 oocyte retrieval cycles from overweight/obese women undergoing IVF at a single center in China from 2013 to 2021, with 130 cycles from each group (rhFSH/rhLH and rhFSH alone) included after propensity score matching.
finding: In overweight/obese women undergoing IVF, recombinant human FSH supplementation with recombinant human LH did not significantly improve the cumulative live birth rate or other pregnancy outcomes compared with rhFSH alone.
